lines.speaker: unbaker
lines.text: You're in my way. I have a route. The route has no kids in it.

lines.speaker: tadzio
lines.text: What's the bread for?

lines.speaker: unbaker
lines.text: It's yesterday's. It goes back before morning. Two in the cart, one to go.
You carry the last loaf to the cart. It's heavier than bread should be.

lines.speaker: unbaker
lines.text: Now the list. I count, you check.

lines.speaker: unbaker
lines.text: No. Two were in the cart. You carried one. Count again.

lines.speaker: unbaker
lines.text: Hey! I'm counting!

lines.speaker: unbaker
lines.text: Stop that! I'll lose my place!

lines.speaker: unbaker
lines.text: Three. Three loaves. All accounted for.

lines.speaker: unbaker
lines.text: You count good, for a kid off the list.
He tears the heel off a loaf and hands it to you.
You got a heel of bread.

lines.speaker: unbaker
lines.text: Forget it! I'll do the whole route backward!

lines.speaker: unbaker
lines.text: Tell the Foreman I'm owed a loaf.
The Un-Baker storms off, cart rattling.

lines.speaker: curfew
lines.text: Hush now... hush now... let's get you back to bed... high, low, and in between...

lines.speaker: tadzio
lines.text: When did you last sleep?

lines.speaker: curfew
lines.text: Sleep? I put everyone else to sleep... I don't think I ever have.
You fluff the biggest pillow. It sighs.

lines.speaker: curfew
lines.text: Hum my song back to me... high notes fall on the right, low on the left...

lines.speaker: curfew
lines.text: Mmm... no... that one is for owls.
You tuck the quilt in, all the way around. It's a big quilt.

lines.speaker: curfew
lines.text: Now, now... not very sleepy of you.

lines.speaker: curfew
lines.text: Shhh... you'll wake the whole town.

lines.speaker: curfew
lines.text: Mmm... so this is what it's like...
Curfew yawns. It is an enormous yawn. The whole square yawns with it.

lines.speaker: curfew
lines.text: Fine... fine... I'm clocking out early.

lines.speaker: curfew
lines.text: Somebody else can tuck you in tonight.

lines.speaker: unbaker
lines.text: ...Nobody ever asks.

lines.speaker: unbaker
lines.text: Careful. That one was a birthday.

lines.speaker: unbaker
lines.text: One. Two. Don't make me lose count.

lines.speaker: unbaker
lines.text: Crumbs! Who leaves crumbs?

lines.speaker: unbaker
lines.text: Yesterday's bread waits for no one.

lines.speaker: unbaker
lines.text: Fourteen. Thirteen. Hold STILL.
The Un-Baker counts the cart. Again.
The street smells like yesterday's bread.
The Un-Baker taps his list with a floury finger.
The cart squeaks. The Un-Baker glares at it.

lines.speaker: curfew
lines.text: Oh... nobody fluffs for me.

lines.speaker: curfew
lines.text: Hush now... high, low, and in between...

lines.speaker: curfew
lines.text: Yaaawn... the room is getting bigger...

lines.speaker: curfew
lines.text: Tuck in the corners... tuck in the edges...

lines.speaker: curfew
lines.text: Lights out, little one.
Curfew hums. The cobbles get sleepy.
Curfew's eyes close... then open again.
Somewhere, a pillow sighs.
The square smells like warm laundry.
